description: Heyes and Curry continue working toward their pardon while their identities remain dangerous currency. Jailbreaks, posses, con men, bounty hunters, bank schemes and old outlaw connections repeatedly force them to survive through nerve, charm and elaborate deception rather than returning to robbery.

s02e01.description: Kid Curry faces the gallows, leaving Heyes to navigate a high-stakes effort to keep his partner alive without exposing them both.

s02e02.description: Heyes and Curry become involved in a bank robbery scheme that turns into a lesson in how many ways a supposedly simple plan can go wrong.

s02e03.description: A jailbreak at Junction City forces Heyes and Curry to balance survival, loyalty and the risk of being identified as the very outlaws they claim not to be.

s02e04.description: A dangerous gunman puts Heyes and Curry in a situation where charm and cleverness may not be enough to keep the shooting from starting.

s02e05.description: A relentless posse refuses to give up the chase, forcing Heyes and Curry to stay ahead of men who have no intention of accepting explanations.

s02e06.description: Heyes and Curry land in trouble where the threat of hanging makes even their usual risky improvisation look unusually urgent.

s02e07.description: Six strangers converge at Apache Springs, and Heyes and Curry must work out which of them can be trusted before the situation turns deadly.

s02e08.description: A dangerous conflict involving the Red Dog puts Heyes and Curry in the middle of another violent frontier dispute they would rather solve without gunplay.

s02e09.description: Harry Briscoe's attempt at reform draws Heyes and Curry into a scheme where an old acquaintance's new respectability proves less simple than advertised.

s02e10.description: A woman named Clementine becomes the center of a troublesome situation that puts Heyes and Curry's judgment, loyalties and aliases under pressure.

s02e11.description: Trouble at Diablo Station places Heyes and Curry between armed men and competing agendas, with very little room for an honest exit.

s02e12.description: A bounty hunter presents an obvious problem for two famous fugitives trying to live as ordinary drifters while their faces remain worth money.

s02e13.description: Heyes and Curry find themselves surrounded by people whose definition of property is flexible enough to make two retired thieves look almost respectable.

s02e14.description: A situation in Santa Marta acquires the air of a miracle, though Heyes and Curry still have to deal with the very practical motives of the people involved.

s02e15.description: With only twenty-one days connected to Tenstrike, Heyes and Curry race against circumstances that leave them unusually little time to improvise.

s02e16.description: McCreedy returns for another elaborate contest of possession and deception, with Heyes and Curry again caught in a game where nothing stays sold for long.

s02e17.description: Heyes and Curry encounter a town whose respectable citizens have discovered that corruption can be practiced just as efficiently without an outlaw gang.

s02e18.description: A bank-breaking scheme at Red Gap pulls Heyes and Curry into one more elaborate financial adventure where winning and escaping are separate problems.
